final:
checked_add(a: int, b: int) -> int? =
  ex checked_add(1, 2) == 3
  ex checked_add(9223372036854775807, 1) == None
  ex checked_add(-9223372036854775807, -2) == None
  let max_val = 9223372036854775807
  let min_val = -9223372036854775807 - 1
  if b > 0 and a > max_val - b
    return None
  if b < 0 and a < min_val - b
    return None
  a + b
